text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYBEAN SALE - Brazilian processor Ceval Alimentos has sold 50,000 tonnes soybeans to a U.S. firm for May shipment, a company official said.

SOYMEAL SALE - The Korea Feed Association on Friday bought 25,000 tonnes of Brazilian soymeal at $337.50 a tonne C&F, traders said. They said the association bought the soymeal from Continental Grain through a closed tender. Shipment was set for May 5-25 and arrival was slated to the South Korean ports of Kunsan and Ulsan.

RAPESEED MEAL SALE - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) bought 2,500 tonnes of Indian rapeseed meal at $144 a tonne C&F from Peter Cremer. Shipment was set for April to the western port of Inchon.

BARLEY SALE - Tunisia on Friday bought 100,000 tonnes of new-crop, optional-origin barley in four cargoes of 25,000 tonnes each at a price of $136.72 per tonne for all four cargoes, European grain traders said. Shipment dates are Sept 5-15, Oct 1-10, Oct 20-30 and Nov 20-30.

WHEAT SALE - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly bought 23,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp, company officials said on Friday. Of the total, Cheiljedang bought 9,500 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, they said. Dongah Flour purchased the remaining 13,500 tonnes at fixed prices. Shipment was set for May 5-June 5 to the southeastern port of Pusan.

WHEAT SALE - India's state-run State Trading Corp (STC) said on Friday it had contracted to import 2.74 million tonnes of wheat since December 1996. STC chairman B.K. Chaturvedi said STC contracted 1.74 million tonnes for import in 1996/97 (April-March). In the last week of March, STC contracted for another one million tonnes for arrival after August 1997.
RICE TENDER - Syria seeks 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment between April 20 and May 20. April 8 is the final date for bids and result will be announced on April 16.
VEGOIL TENDER - Algeria is expected to tender for 20,000 tonnes of sunoil over the weekend, for May shipment.

CORN AND WHEAT TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders for the supply of a combined shipment of 10,000 tonnes spring and 8,000 tonnes durum wheat, and a shipment of 18,000 tonnes of corn. Shipment for the combined wheat cargo is scheduled at the end of April or the beginning of May, while the corn shipment is scheduled for the beginning of May 1997. Both tenders close on April 8.
BARLEY TENDER - The South African Wheat Board said it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale no later than April 30.

MARKET TALK - U.S. Agriculture Department General Sales Manager Chris Goldthwait said on Friday that Chinese grain imports would stay modest this year...Goldthwait also said in Moscow on Friday that Russia's grain import needs would be fairly modest...The vessel Kardamyla left the Brazilian port of Paranagua with 53,362 tonnes of soybeans on March 31 destined for the port of New Orleans, Louisiana, shipping agent Transcar said...A World Trade Organisation dispute panel will almost certainly be set up next week to look into a U.S. complaint that European Union grain tariffs violate the body's rules, trade diplomats said.
